Action plan

Your simplest route to 270 kWh.

Three practical actions, chosen for your household profile.

33%plan complete
High impactAir conditioning

Keep cooling at 24–26°C

Pair the temperature setting with a fan and close doors to cool the occupied space first.

Cooling is your largest self-reported appliance category. A small thermostat adjustment is an easy, repeatable habit.
Potential12–18kWh / month
Medium impactNight routine

Use a 2-hour sleep timer

Pre-cool the room, then let the timer switch off the air conditioner after you fall asleep.

Set one reusable timer on the remote tonight. Keep a fan on low after the air conditioner stops.
Potential8–12kWh / month
Easy winStandby power

Switch off one entertainment zone

Use a switched power strip for the TV, console, speakers and chargers when they are idle.

Place the power strip where the switch is visible. Add it to your leaving-home routine.
Potential3–5kWh / month
Your targetUp to 35 kWh

How it works

Clear inputs. Traceable results.

CarbonPulse distinguishes the things you record from the things we estimate.

Your confirmed kWh is multiplied by the disclosed Peninsular Malaysia grid factor.

Pick practical changes that suit your routines, then track what you complete.
